svg.title: DenseNet-121 architecture with multi-label output head
svg.desc: Structural diagram showing DenseNet-121 pipeline: input image through initial conv, four dense blocks with transition layers, global average pooling, fully connected layer, and 14 sigmoid outputs for chest pathology classification.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the fully connected layer do in CheXNet?')
sendPrompt('What is Cardiomegaly on chest X-ray?')
sendPrompt('What is a Hiatal Hernia on chest X-ray?')

svg.text: Growth rate k = 32 throughout all dense blocks
Fig. 1. DenseNet-121 with multi-label output head. DB = dense block, T = transition layer, GAP = global average pooling, k = growth rate.
